companies.name: ヤク
companies.sub: 仮設マット・アクセス

relations.text: 2024年3月に、仮設マットのYak Access・Yak Matなど(総称Yak)を買収
relations.text_en: Acquired Yak Access, Yak Mat and New South Access & Environmental Solutions ("Yak") in March 2024

source.label: United Rentals 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In March 2024, we completed the acquisition of Yak Access, LLC, Yak Mat, LLC and New South Access & Environmental Solutions, LLC (collectively, "Yak").

relations.text: 2025年1月にH&Eの買収合意を発表したが、合意は解消された(解約に伴う受取額を計上)
relations.text_en: Announced a merger agreement to buy H&E in January 2025; the deal was later terminated and United Rentals booked a termination benefit

source.label: United Rentals 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: (6) In January 2025, we announced that we had signed a merger agreement to acquire H&E.

companies.name: ノース・アメリカン・コンストラクション

relations.text: North American Constructionが、20年超の補助機材レンタルの取引先としてUnited Rentalsを挙げる
relations.text_en: North American Construction lists United Rentals as a supplier of support equipment rentals for over 20 years

source.label: North American Construction 年次報告(2025年度、40-F添付)
source.label_en: North American Construction annual report (FY2025, 40-F exhibit)
source.quote: United Rentals (over 20 years), a supplier of support equipment rentals;

companies.name: サンベルト・レンタルズ

relations.text: Sunbelt Rentalsが10-Kで、北米最大級の全国規模の競合としてUnited Rentalsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Sunbelt Rentals names United Rentals among its largest national competitors in North America

source.label: Sunbelt Rentals 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: In North America, our largest national competitors include United Rentals, Herc Rentals and EquipmentShare.

relations.text: Hercが10-Kで、全国規模の競合としてUnited Rentalsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Herc names United Rentals among the large national companies it competes with

source.label: Herc 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our competitors in the equipment rental industry range from other large national companies (United Rentals, Inc., Ashtead Group plc's Sunbelt Rentals brand and H&E Equipment Services, Inc.)

companies.name: ウィルスコット
companies.sub: 仮設オフィス・コンテナのレンタル

relations.text: WillScotが10-Kで、主な競合の一社としてUnited Rentalsを挙げる
relations.text_en: WillScot names United Rentals among its significant competitors

source.label: WillScot 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Significant competitors include McGrath RentCorp, United Rentals, ATCO Structures & Logistics, and Satellite Shelters.

relations.text: Xylemが10-Kで、水関連サービスの主な競合としてUnited Rentalsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Xylem names United Rentals among key competitors in water solutions and services

source.label: Xylem 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our key competitors in the Water Solutions and Services segment include Ecolab, MPW Industrial Services, Ovivo, Sunbelt Rentals and United Rentals.

companies.name: NPKインターナショナル
companies.sub: 複合材マットのレンタル

relations.text: NPKが10-Kで、マットのレンタル市場で最大の競合としてUnited Rentalsを挙げる
relations.text_en: NPK names United Rentals as the largest competitor in the mat rental market

source.label: NPK International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: United Rentals is the largest competitor in the rental market, primarily using wood mats.
